syncDesktopDescription: Connect an account, choose what to sync, then add the local data you want to share with that account.
syncServerDescription: Manage devices authorized to sync configurations owned by your current account. Sign in and approve access in a browser from the desktop app.
syncScope: Sync your own server configurations with their groups and tags, and personal scripts. Shared resources are excluded.
syncCredentialsHint: Server passwords, SSH private keys, personal AI configuration and AI conversations can be authorized and enabled separately. Connecting never uploads unselected local data.
syncDeleteHint: Deletions propagate to other devices. Sync does not replace backups; sessions, tasks, and logs remain on each device.
syncInitialHint: The first connection receives remote configuration without uploading existing local data. Select local configuration to join the sync space; newly created local configuration must also be added explicitly.
syncDisconnectConfirm: Remove the local credential and attempt to revoke this device remotely? Offline data and its original account ownership will remain and will not be uploaded to another account automatically.
syncNoDevices: No authorized devices. Enter this server address in the desktop app, then sign in and approve access.
syncRevokeConfirm: This device will no longer be able to sync. Data already synced to the device will remain there. Continue?
syncConflictHint: Conflicting fields keep their current local values until you choose a version. New records with unresolved conflicts are not added locally. You can save other conversation versions separately. Credential previews never display secrets.
syncLoginExpired: Authorization expired. Please sign in again.
syncLoginWaiting: Sign in and approve access in the browser that was opened.
syncLoginCodeHint: Check that the browser shows the same verification code. This request expires in 5 minutes.
syncRevocationPending: Signed out locally, but remote revocation could not be confirmed. Revoke this device in Web account settings.
syncEnrollHint: After enabling a content type, select existing records to add. Records from another account are copied; server passwords and private keys are excluded from those copies.
syncNoLocalRecords: No records in this category remain to be added.
syncEnrollConfirm: Add {count} selected configurations to {account} ({url})? Configurations from other accounts will be copied as new records and retain their original ownership.
syncWebLoginHint: Enter this server address in the desktop app and select “Sign in with browser”. Approved devices appear below. Authorization lasts 90 days; sign out and sign in again to reconnect the same space after expiry.
syncPermissionHint: Bidirectional sync requires server management permission to create, update and delete your own connections. You can still view and revoke devices. System backup permission is not required.
syncAuthorizeDescription: Verify the device and account, choose the content it may access, then approve this connection.
syncAuthorizeCheck: I initiated this request and verified that this code matches the desktop app.
syncAuthorizeDone: Authorization complete. Return to the desktop app to finish connecting automatically.
syncScopeCredentialsHint: Sync passwords and SSH private keys for servers enrolled in this space. Temporary private-key passphrases are excluded.
syncScopeAIConfig: Personal AI configuration and API key
syncScopeAIConfigHint: Sync this space’s personal provider, models and API key. Shared system AI keys are excluded.
syncScopeSessionsHint: Sync conversations, messages, attachments and historical tool results. Received conversations use read-only permissions without restoring terminal connections or replaying tasks. New conversations join this space while enabled; existing local conversations require selection.
syncScopeNeedsGrant: This device is not authorized for this scope. Disconnect and sign in again to grant access.
syncVaultTrustHint: HTTPS protects transport; credentials and sync objects are encrypted at rest on both ends. The server can decrypt the data: connect only to a server you trust. This is not end-to-end encryption.
syncScopeDisableHint: Turning off a content type stops future sync and keeps existing copies.
syncCopyAIConfig: Copy local AI configuration into this space
syncCopyAIConfigConfirm: Copy the unassigned local AI configuration, including its API key, into this space, replacing its personal configuration and syncing it? Other accounts’ configurations will not be copied.
syncBasicScope: Server settings, groups, tags and scripts only
syncForkSaved: Saved as a separate conversation. The original conflict remains available for resolution.
instanceDescription: Create native database snapshots with application data, external files, and the root key. Encrypted archives support full recovery or migration within the same app type; use device sync for personal data across web and desktop.
instanceWorking: Operation in progress; status updates automatically
instancePasswordNote: Passwords are used only for this operation and are never saved. Keep your password: a forgotten password cannot be recovered. File transfers may briefly wait during a snapshot; retry if existing transfers are still active.
instanceRestoreNote: Restoration creates and verifies a separate copy, preserving the active instance. Switch the instance startup configuration to use restored data. Deleting an archive does not delete restored copies.
instanceRestoreUnavailable: An external database is in use. A deployment administrator must configure EASYSSH_RESTORE_DSN with a new empty target database before restoration.
instanceRestoredTo: Verified copy prepared; active instance has not switched: {path}
instanceDeleteConfirm: Delete “{name}” and its archive permanently? Current application data and restored copies are unaffected.
instanceEmpty: No backups yet. Create a full backup or upload an existing .easyssh.age archive.
instanceRestoreConfirm: Decrypt and verify this archive, then restore it into a new directory. The active instance will keep its current data; it will not be overwritten or switched automatically. Login and device grants in the copy will be invalidated. The restored directory will be shown on completion.
instanceTaskStarted: Operation started; follow its status in backup history
instanceUploadTooLarge: Backup files must not exceed 16 GiB
instanceUploadDone: Backup uploaded; verify it with its password before restoring
instanceActivationNote: Activate a restored copy and restart after restoration succeeds. The original instance is retained and restored automatically if startup validation fails. Deleting an archive does not delete restored copies.
instanceActivateConfirm: Activate the restored copy of “{name}” ({date}) and restart? Terminal and transfer connections will close. Sign in again using an account from the backup. The original instance is retained; subsequent changes are not merged between instances.
instanceRollbackConfirm: Stop this instance and restart the previous one? Connections will close and you must sign in again. New data remains in this instance's directory and is not merged into the previous instance.
instanceRestartWaiting: Stopping the current instance and starting the selected copy. The service may be temporarily unavailable. This page will check the result automatically.
instanceRestartSucceeded: The instance was switched successfully. Sign in again and verify your data.
instanceRestartRolledBack: The last switch was interrupted or startup validation failed. The previous instance was restored. Your original data is retained. Sign in again and check the server logs for details.
instanceRestartTimeout: The service has not confirmed recovery; success is not established. Check the server logs and launcher, then continue checking. Keep the original data directory.
instanceDesktopActivateConfirm: Activate the restored copy of “{name}” ({date})? EasySSH will close and reopen. Active terminals, transfers and AI requests will be interrupted. The original instance and key will be retained; data will not be merged.
instanceDesktopRollbackConfirm: EasySSH will close and reopen the previous instance. Active connections and operations will be interrupted. The current instance and key will be retained; new data will not be merged.
instanceDesktopRestartWaiting: Switching instances. EasySSH will close and reopen automatically.
instanceDesktopRestartSucceeded: The instance was activated. Please verify the restored data.
instanceDesktopRestartRolledBack: The switch was interrupted or startup validation failed. The previous instance is active and its data and key are retained. See the launcher log for details.
syncActionFailed: The operation did not complete. Review the details and try again.
syncExchangeFailed: Some data could not be synced
syncContentHint: Choose the content types for this account and save them together. Manage individual records under Data on this device.
syncBaseHint: Includes connections, groups, tags and scripts. Both existing and newly created local servers and scripts must be added manually.
syncSessionsSummary: Sync messages, attachments and historical tool results. New conversations join automatically while enabled; select existing ones below. Received conversations are read-only and never replay tasks.
syncLocalAIConfig: Use this device’s original AI configuration
syncLocalAIConfigHint: Sync uses this account’s AI configuration. Copy the unassigned local configuration here to replace it, including the API key.
syncUnsavedScopes: Changes are not saved. Sync still uses the previous settings.
syncPausedSettingsHint: Sync is paused. You can change content and add records; data is exchanged after resuming.
syncAIConfigCopied: AI configuration copied to this account
syncDataEnrolled: Selected records added to this account
syncSessionsDisabledHint: Conversation sync is off. Enable and save it above before adding conversations. Previously added conversations are kept.
syncNoEnrolled: No records in this category have been added yet.
syncEnrolledPaused: Added to this account · Sync paused
syncInCurrentSpace: Added to this account · Included in sync
syncEnrollPausedHint: Records stay on this device until sync resumes.
syncEnrollScheduleHint: Adding records schedules sync. Check the result at the top of this page.
syncTimingHint: When enabled, sync runs on startup, after reconnecting or editing local data, and on manual request. Switching windows does not trigger sync; updates from other devices arrive on the next sync.
syncAuthorizeVerifyHint: Confirm that you started this connection in the desktop app and that both verification codes match.
syncAuthorizeVerificationCode: Compare this code with the desktop app
syncAuthorizeCodeHint: Confirm that this matches the code in the desktop app. This request expires 5 minutes after it was created.
syncAuthorizeScopesHint: This grants the device access. After connecting, enable the corresponding content types in the desktop app and select existing local records to add.
syncAuthorizeBaseHint: Allows syncing connections, groups, tags and personal scripts owned by this account. Shared resources, system backups and other users’ data are excluded.
syncAuthorizeCredentialsHint: Allows access to passwords and SSH private keys for enrolled servers. Temporary private-key passphrases are excluded.
syncAuthorizeAIConfigHint: Allows access to this account’s personal AI provider, models and API key. Shared system keys are excluded.
syncAuthorizeSessionsHint: Allows access to AI messages, attachments and historical tool results. Received conversations are read-only, without restoring terminal connections or replaying tasks.
syncAuthorizeGrantTo: Allow “{name}” to access the following content in account “{account}”:
syncAuthorizeValidity: Device authorization lasts 90 days. Revoke it at any time under Device sync in your web account settings.
syncAuthorizeDeniedHint: This request was cancelled and can no longer be approved. Start a new connection from the desktop app if needed.
syncAuthorizeNextStep: Next, choose sync content in the desktop app and add records under Data on this device. Authorization alone does not upload local data that has not been added.
syncAuthorizeExpiredHint: This request expired or no longer exists. Start a new connection from the desktop app and use the newly opened authorization page.
syncAuthorizeInvalidHint: This authorization link is incomplete or invalid. Start a new connection from the desktop app.
syncAuthorizeDeviceLimit: The limit of 20 authorized devices has been reached. Revoke an unused device in account settings, then try again.
